How big a VPS do you need?

Answer two questions. Memory matters most, then fast CPU cores, then disk.

Playkeeper itself needs at least 2 CPU cores, 3 GB of memory and 5 GB of free disk. Sizes are memory for the whole VPS. More than 40 friends at once? Start with the biggest size and watch the Overview.

More than one server on the VPS?

They add up. Every server counts, running or not: Playkeeper keeps a stopped server's memory, so it can always start.

Memory
Add up what each server gets for the world, then 2 GB for Ubuntu, Docker and Playkeeper once, and pick the next size up.
CPU
The busiest server's cores, plus one for each other server.
Disk
Add up each server's.

For example, Paper for 5–10 friends (4 GB for the world) and a big modpack for 1–4 friends (8 GB for the world): 4 + 8 + 2 = 14 GB, so a VPS with 16 GB of memory, 6 fast cores and 80 GB SSD.

Got your VPS? Install Playkeeper

On Ubuntu 24.04 LTS (x86_64), as a user who can use sudo:

curl -fsSL https://playkeeper.io/install | sudo sh
